messages:
Nora: Heads-up — launch next Tue. We need a short redirect governance + internal-link remediation plan for webinar + benchmark posts. Quick sync?

Maggie: Yes. Minimal goals: preserve link equity for top organic pages, avoid chains, and update internal links so they point to final canonicals (not intermediate redirects).

Elsa: Plan to run a Screaming Frog crawl and export top 250 organic pages. Will flag internal links pointing to soon-to-be-redirected URLs.

Raj: Redirect policy suggestion: use 301 for permanent consolidations, 307 for temporary A/B or promo preserves (keeps method), and avoid meta-refreshes. Example nginx rule for permanent: 
```
location /old-benchmark/ {
  return 301 https://redwood.ai/blog/benchmarks;
}
```

Sam: Analytics note: do NOT seed UTM params on internal nav changes. Track sources at entry points (email, paid, social) with utm_source values: newsletter, paid_social, organic. For short promos add utm_campaign=promo-YYYYMM.

MarketingOps Bot: Created Asana task: "SEO redirect governance - launch" https://app.asana.com/0/123456789/987654321 :spiral_calendar: Assigning Elsa/Raj/Sam.

Maggie: Internal-link checklist: 1) update site nav (header/footer) to canonical URLs, 2) update CTAs inside posts, 3) run a find/replace on old internal hrefs in CMS export. Add rel=canonical on moved posts pointing to new hub.

Raj: I'll open infra/redirects PR. Will include tests to detect chains. Small CI test I plan to add: 
```python
# simple chain check
import requests
r = requests.head('https://redwood.ai/old-page', allow_redirects=True)
assert r.history[0].status_code == 301
assert r.url.endswith('/blog/benchmarks')
```

Elsa: ETA for crawl + CSV: Monday EOD. Will include column "internal_links_to_deprecated" so content can be updated.

Sam: I'll prepare GA4 event spec for webinar_reg and bench_engagement. Need final canonical URLs by Mon 5pm to wire conversions.

Nora: Can infra schedule the redirect deploy Wed night to avoid launch-day churn? Staging QA Thur morning?

Raj: Yes, targeting Wed 23:00. I'll add smoke tests: curl -I checks, then a Screaming Frog quick crawl. Example: 
```
curl -I https://redwood.ai/old-benchmark
# expect: HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
```

MarketingOps Bot: Reminder: add structured data for pages — Webinar (schema: Event), Benchmarks (schema: Article + FAQ). Also remember to set <lastmod> on sitemap for the new landing.

Maggie: SEO nuance: prefer canonical + 301 rather than relying on the sitemap alone. Also avoid adding multiple canonicals on a page. If we temporarily redirect a seasonal page, use 307 so downstream link tracking that depends on method isn't broken.

Sam: Quick ask: for paid social landing tests, please include ?src=paid_social so we can segregate in BigQuery. But strip utm on canonical links for SEO.

Raj: I'll ensure redirects don't append tracking params automatically. We'll rely on initial entry tagging. Also will whitelist only known query params in redirect rules.

Elsa: After crawl I'll push a CSV with columns: url, organic_sessions, proposed_action, new_url, owner. That should make the content updates straightforward.

Deploy Bot: PR 432 merged to infra/redirects and deployed to staging. Run your QA checks and report issues here. :white_check_mark:

Maggie: Great work. Next steps: Elsa post CSV, Raj open PR link + CI test, Sam finish GA4 wiring, MarketingOps Bot open schema PR. We'll run a post-deploy audit Fri morning (sitemap check, Screaming Frog, Lighthouse run). Ping thread with PR links.

Nora: Thanks everyone — please DM if you need more runway.
